patterns: burn on hand from hot kettle
responses:
First Aid Guidance:
• Minor Burn: Run cool tap water over the area for 10-15 minutes. Do not apply ice or butter.
• Sprain: Follow R.I.C.E (Rest, Ice for 15-20 min, Compression, Elevation).
• Bleeding cut: Apply firm direct pressure with a clean cloth.
• Nosebleed: Lean forward slightly and pinch soft part of nose for 10 minutes.
First aid kits are maintained with the Hostel Warden and floor security desks.

Drinking water safety is critical for student health. Please do not consume discolored or foul-smelling water. Please file an official report using the 'Report an Issue' tab under 'Drinking Water' category so the maintenance team can inspect and replace filters.

patterns: stale smelling food in hostel mess
mess utensils are greasy and unwashed
responses: Food safety issues must be addressed immediately. Please submit a complaint in the 'Report an Issue' section under 'Food Hygiene' with your hostel block and mess session details. If you are experiencing food poisoning symptoms (vomiting, cramps), visit the health center immediately.

Sanitation is essential to prevent contagious infections. Please log this issue under the 'Washrooms & Sanitation' or 'Waste Disposal' category in 'Report an Issue' mentioning your floor/room number for prompt cleaning.

⚠️ SAFETY HAZARD: Do not touch damaged sockets or sparking appliances! Switch off the main room trip if safe to do so. Immediately inform the hostel security desk and submit an urgent complaint under 'Electrical & Fire Safety'.

You can track any complaint instantly in the 'My Complaints' section by entering your Complaint ID (e.g., HC-XXXXXX). You will see real-time status updates: Submitted, In Progress, or Resolved, along with administrator notes.

Hostel Safety Guidelines:
• Curfew / in-time is 9:30 PM (verify with your block rules).
• Security control desk operates 24/7 at the main hostel gate.
• Emergency staircases must remain clear at all times.
• Anti-Ragging & Student Safety committee helpline is available 24/7 through warden office.

responses:
Key Health Habits for Hostel Living:
1. Drink at least 2.5-3 liters of clean, filtered water daily.
2. Wash hands thoroughly with soap before mess meals.
3. Avoid sharing personal items like towels, water bottles, and pillows.
4. Keep your room ventilated and sanitize common touchpoints.
